title: SEC0: data race on g_tls_safe_mode write
description: g_tls_safe_mode is a plain static int read and written without any mutex. If two threads call wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid() or wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid_ssl() concurrently, the write g_tls_safe_mode=1 is an unsynchronized store while the callback may be simultaneously reading it (unsynchronized load in wc_crypto2dev_cb). Under C11 this is a data race and undefined behavior. In practice both threads write the same value (1 to 1) so the race is benign on cache-coherent architectures with single-word stores, but it is formally UB and will trip ThreadSanitizer. wolfssl-bvs.5 covers the semantic 'never reset' bug; this is the distinct concurrency bug.
